import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

cases = [
    ('unclosed quote', 'a,b\\r\\n1,\"oops\\r\\n', ['--output', 'json'], 1),
    ('blank number', 'g,n\\r\\na,\\r\\n', ['--group-by', 'g', '--sum', 'n'], 1),
    ('non-finite number', 'g,n\\r\\na,NaN\\r\\n', ['--group-by', 'g', '--avg', 'n'], 1),
    ('empty filter value', 'a,b\\r\\n1,\\r\\n', ['--where', 'b='], 0),
]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
    for name, body, args, expected in cases:
        path = Path(directory) / f'{name}.csv'
        path.write_text(body, encoding='utf-8', newline='')
        result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'main.py', str(path), *args], capture_output=True)
        assert result.returncode == expected, (name, result.returncode, result.stderr)
        if expected:
            assert not result.stdout, (name, result.stdout)
    output_path = Path(directory) / 'out.csv'
    output_path.write_text('a,b\\r\\n1,\"x,y\"\\r\\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='')
    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, 'main.py', str(output_path), '--output', 'csv'], capture_output=True)
    assert result.stdout == b'a,b\\r\\n1,\"x,y\"\\r\\n', result.stdout
print('additional edge-case checks: OK')
PY
python3 -m unittest discover -v"
